title: List non-compliant Intune devices with last sync time
summary: Every Intune-managed device in a noncompliant state with its user, OS and last check-in, sorted so stale devices surface first.
code:
Connect-MgGraph -Scopes 'DeviceManagementManagedDevices.Read.All'

Get-MgDeviceManagementManagedDevice -All -Filter "complianceState eq 'noncompliant'" |
  Select-Object DeviceName, UserPrincipalName, OperatingSystem, OsVersion, LastSyncDateTime |
  Sort-Object LastSyncDateTime |
  Format-Table -AutoSize
notes: Devices that haven't synced within the compliance status validity period turn non-compliant on their own; old LastSyncDateTime values point to that cause.
Other complianceState values you can filter on: inGracePeriod, conflict, error, unknown.

source.label: Why Intune devices stay non-compliant: causes and diagnosis
